董事會為週一的簡報預訂了最大的會議室。
The CEO answered reporters' questions at the afternoon press conference.
執行長在下午的記者會上回答了記者的提問。

words.d: the feeling that you can trust or be sure about something or someone
x: Strong quarterly results boosted investors' confidence in the company.
亮眼的季度業績提升了投資人對公司的信心。
Rising wages have helped to build consumer confidence this quarter.
工資上漲有助於在本季提升消費者信心。
Clients have great confidence in our ability to meet deadlines.
客戶對我們如期完成的能力極有信心。

words.m: 有信心的；確信的；自信的
words.d: sure that something will happen or that you can do something well
x: The director is confident that the new branch will succeed.
總監深具信心，認為新分店一定會成功。
The team feels confident about launching the product next month.
團隊對下個月推出這項產品感到有信心。
Investors are confident that the new strategy will increase profits.
投資人有信心新策略將會提高利潤。
c: (adj.) 機密的、保密的：confidential files 機密檔案。

words.d: meant to be kept secret and not told to other people
x: Please keep all client records strictly confidential at all times.
請務必隨時將所有客戶資料嚴格保密。
The confidential documents must be stored in a locked cabinet.
這些機密文件必須存放在上鎖的櫃子裡。
Salary details are strictly confidential and should not be shared.
薪資細節是嚴格保密的，不應對外透露。
c: (adj.) 有信心的、確信的：confident of winning。

words.d: to state or show that something is definitely true or arranged
x: Please call the hotel to confirm your reservation before arrival.
抵達前請致電飯店確認您的訂房。
Please confirm receipt of this invoice by replying to the email.
請回覆此電子郵件以確認收到這張發票。
The client called to confirm the appointment for Thursday afternoon.
客戶來電確認週四下午的約定。

words.d: a message or document that proves something is arranged or true
x: You will receive a confirmation email shortly after completing your booking.
完成訂位後，您很快就會收到確認信。
Keep your confirmation number handy when you check in at the counter.
在櫃檯辦理報到時，請把你的確認號碼準備好。
Guests should print their booking confirmation before arriving at the hotel.
賓客在抵達飯店前應列印他們的訂房確認單。

words.d: a serious disagreement, or a situation in which two things cannot happen together
x: Due to a scheduling conflict, the workshop has been moved to Thursday.
由於時間撞期，工作坊已改到週四舉行。
The manager must declare any possible conflict of interest before voting.
經理在投票前必須申報任何可能的利益衝突。
The two meetings conflict, so I can only attend one.
這兩場會議時間撞期，所以我只能參加一場。

words.d: to tell someone that you are happy about their success
x: The CEO congratulated the sales team on exceeding their annual targets.
執行長祝賀業務團隊超越年度目標。
The director warmly congratulated the intern on her successful presentation.
主管熱情地祝賀實習生簡報成功。
Colleagues gathered to congratulate the winner of the sales award.
同事們聚在一起祝賀銷售獎的得主。

words.d: an expression used to praise someone for a success or achievement
x: Congratulations on your promotion to regional manager of the sales division.
恭喜您升任業務部區域經理。
The whole team offered their congratulations on the successful merger.
整個團隊為成功的合併致上他們的祝賀。
Please extend my congratulations to everyone involved in the project.
請代我向參與這項專案的每個人致上祝賀。

words.d: to join two or more things together, or to link to a network or phone line
x: I cannot connect to the office network from my laptop.
我的筆電無法連上公司的網路。
Passengers must hurry to catch their connecting flight in the next terminal.
乘客必須趕往隔壁航廈搭乘他們的轉接班機。
The technician helped me connect the printer to the office network.
技術人員幫我把印表機連接到辦公室網路。

words.m: 連線；連接；轉乘班機；關聯
words.d: the state of being joined or linked, especially to a network or transportation service
x: The hotel offers a stable Internet connection in every room.
這家飯店每間客房都提供穩定的網路連線。
A weak Internet connection made the video conference difficult to follow.
微弱的網路連線使得視訊會議難以跟上。
The heavy snow caused many travelers to miss their connections.
大雪使得許多旅客錯過了他們的轉乘班機。

words.d: following one after another without interruption
x: The company has reported record profits for five consecutive quarters.
該公司已連續五季創下獲利新高。
The store has increased its sales for three consecutive years.
這家店已連續三年提高銷售額。
Staff cannot take more than ten consecutive days of leave.
員工請假不得超過連續十天。

words.d: a general agreement among all the members of a group
x: Board members finally reached a consensus on the merger proposal.
董事會成員終於就合併案達成共識。
The committee worked hard to build consensus among all its members.
委員會努力在所有成員之間建立共識。
There is a broad consensus that the office needs more storage space.
大家普遍有共識，認為辦公室需要更多的儲物空間。

words.d: permission or agreement to do something
x: Employees may not share client data without written consent from management.
未經管理階層書面同意，員工不得外流客戶資料。
Photographs may not be published without the client's written consent.
未經客戶的書面同意，照片不得刊登。
The patient must give consent before any procedure can begin.
在任何療程開始前，病人必須表示同意。

words.d: as a result of something that has just been mentioned
x: The shipment was delayed; consequently, the product launch was postponed.
貨運延誤，因此產品上市時間也順延了。
Demand rose sharply; consequently, the factory added a night shift.
需求大幅上升，因此工廠增加了夜班。
The supplier raised its prices, and consequently our costs increased.
供應商調漲了價格，因此我們的成本也隨之增加。

words.d: to think carefully about something before making a decision
x: The committee will consider all applications before making a final decision.
委員會將在做出最終決定前審慎考量所有申請案。
The manager asked us to consider the offer carefully before replying.
經理要我們在回覆前仔細考慮這項提議。
Applicants with overseas experience will be considered for the senior position.
具有海外經驗的應徵者將被列入這個高階職位的考量。

words.d: large in amount, size, or importance
x: The new system saved the company a considerable amount of money.
新系統為公司省下相當可觀的費用。
The candidate has considerable experience in international logistics.
這位候選人在國際物流方面擁有相當豐富的經驗。
Switching suppliers resulted in considerable savings for the company.
更換供應商為公司帶來了可觀的節省。

words.d: by a large amount or degree
x: Shipping costs have risen considerably over the past two years.
過去兩年運費大幅上漲。
Online sales have increased considerably since the website was redesigned.
自從網站重新設計以來，線上銷售大幅成長。
Prices for the same model vary considerably from store to store.
同一款式的價格在各家店之間差異相當大。

words.d: always thinking about other people's feelings and needs
x: Our considerate staff always respond quickly to guest requests.
我們貼心的員工總是迅速回應房客的需求。
It was considerate of the manager to arrange transport for the guests.
經理為賓客安排交通真是體貼。
The considerate flight attendant helped the elderly passenger with her bags.
體貼的空服員幫助年長的乘客拿行李。
c: (adj.) 相當大(多)的：a considerable amount 相當大的數量。

words.d: careful thought about something before making a decision
x: Your proposal is currently under consideration by the management team.
您的提案目前正由管理團隊審核考量中。
The committee will take your suggestions into consideration next week.
委員會下週會將你的建議納入考量。
After careful consideration, the board decided to expand overseas.
經過慎重考慮後，董事會決定向海外擴展。

words.d: to be made up or formed of particular things or people
x: The selection committee consists of five senior managers from different departments.
遴選委員會由五位來自不同部門的資深主管組成。
The training program consists of three online modules and a final test.
這個培訓課程由三個線上單元和一次期末測驗組成。
Our export shipments consist mainly of electronic parts and accessories.
我們的出口貨物主要由電子零件和配件組成。
c: (vt.) 組成、作曲：be composed of… 由…組成
(vt.) 包含、由…組成：The team comprises 5 people.

words.m: 一致的；穩定的；始終如一的
words.d: always behaving, happening, or performing in the same way
x: The factory maintains consistent quality across all its production lines.
這座工廠所有生產線都維持一致的品質。
The company has enjoyed consistent growth over the past decade.
這家公司在過去十年間享有穩定的成長。
These results are consistent with the findings of last year's survey.
這些結果與去年調查的發現一致。

words.m: 一貫地；持續地；始終如一地
words.d: in a way that does not change and stays the same over time
x: The hotel has consistently received excellent reviews from business travelers.
這家飯店一直獲得商務旅客的極佳評價。
Our factory consistently delivers products of high quality.
我們的工廠始終如一地交付高品質的產品。
This airline is consistently ranked among the best in the region.
這家航空公司一貫被評為該地區最頂尖的航空公司之一。

words.d: to combine several things into one in order to become more effective
x: The company plans to consolidate its regional offices into one headquarters.
公司計劃將各地區辦公室整合為單一總部。
The merger allowed the firm to consolidate its position in the market.
這次合併讓公司得以鞏固其市場地位。
Management decided to consolidate operations to cut administrative costs.
管理層決定整合營運以削減行政成本。

words.m: 持續的；不斷的；固定不變的
words.d: happening all the time or staying at the same level without changing

倉庫需要持續監控，以維持適當的溫度。
There is constant demand for reliable childcare near the office.
辦公室附近對可靠的托兒服務有持續的需求。
Despite the busy season, product quality remained constant.
儘管處於旺季，產品品質依然維持不變。

words.d: all the time or very often, without stopping
x: Our website is constantly updated with the latest product information.
我們的網站不斷更新最新的產品資訊。
The travel industry is constantly changing to meet customer expectations.
旅遊業不斷變化以滿足顧客的期望。
The support team works to constantly improve its response times.
支援團隊致力於不斷改善其回應時間。

words.d: to build something large such as a building, road, or bridge
x: The city will construct a new parking garage next to the convention center.
市政府將在會議中心旁興建一座新的停車場。
The firm was hired to construct a new warehouse near the port.
這家公司受雇在港口附近建造一座新倉庫。
The newly constructed terminal can handle twice as many passengers.
新建的航廈能處理兩倍的旅客量。

words.d: the work or process of building houses, offices, roads, or other structures
x: The main road is closed this week due to ongoing construction work.
由於工程持續進行，主要道路本週封閉。
Visitors must wear a helmet when entering the construction site.
訪客進入工地時必須配戴安全帽。
The new shopping mall is still under construction and opens in spring.
新的購物中心仍在興建中，將於春季開幕。

words.d: useful and intended to help improve something rather than criticize it
x: The manager offered constructive feedback on the intern's first sales presentation.
經理針對實習生的第一次銷售簡報提出了建設性的意見。
The reviewers offered constructive criticism to help improve the design.
審查者提出建設性的批評以協助改善設計。
Staff are encouraged to share constructive suggestions during team meetings.
鼓勵員工在團隊會議中分享有建設性的建議。

words.d: to ask a person for advice or look at a source for information
x: Please consult the employee handbook before submitting your vacation request.
提交休假申請前，請先查閱員工手冊。
You should consult a lawyer before signing the overseas contract.
在簽署這份海外合約前，你應該諮詢律師。
The engineer consulted the manual to fix the faulty machine.
工程師查閱手冊以修理故障的機器。

words.d: a person who is paid to give expert advice on a particular subject
x: We hired an outside consultant to improve our customer service procedures.
我們聘請了一位外部顧問來改善客服流程。
The company hired a financial consultant to review its investment plan.
公司聘請了一位財務顧問來檢視其投資計畫。
A management consultant advised the board on cutting operating costs.
一位管理顧問就削減營運成本向董事會提供建議。

words.d: a meeting with an expert to discuss something or get advice
x: The clinic offers a free consultation for all first-time patients.
這家診所為所有初診病患提供免費諮詢。
The policy was revised in consultation with the legal department.
這項政策是在與法務部門商議後修訂的。
Customers can schedule a free consultation with one of our advisers.
顧客可以預約與我們一位顧問的免費諮詢。

words.m: 顧問業；諮詢服務；顧問的
words.d: the business of giving expert advice to companies for a fee
x: She left her corporate job to start her own consulting firm.
她辭去了大公司的工作，自行創立顧問公司。
The consulting firm specializes in helping companies expand into Asia.
這家顧問公司專精於協助企業拓展亞洲市場。
Our consulting services include market research and staff training.
我們的諮詢服務包括市場調查和員工訓練。

words.d: to use fuel, energy, or time, or to eat or drink something
x: The new machines consume far less electricity than the older models.
新機器的耗電量遠低於舊機型。

舊型冷氣機比新型機種消耗更多的能源。
Processing paper invoices by hand is a time-consuming task.
手動處理紙本發票是一件耗時的工作。

words.d: a person who buys goods or services for personal use
x: The survey shows that consumers prefer eco-friendly packaging over plastic.
調查顯示，消費者偏好環保包裝勝過塑膠包裝。
Strong consumer demand pushed the factory to increase production.
強勁的消費者需求促使工廠增加產量。
New consumer protection laws require clearer product labeling.
新的消費者保護法要求更清楚的產品標示。

(n.) 顧客(購物消費者)：a regular customer 常客

words.d: the amount of something that is used, or the act of using it
x: The factory reduced its energy consumption by twenty percent last year.
這座工廠去年將能源消耗量降低了百分之二十。
The new engine design lowers fuel consumption on long trips.
新的引擎設計降低了長途行駛的燃料消耗。
The office aims to reduce paper consumption by going fully digital.
辦公室希望透過全面數位化來減少紙張的消耗。

words.d: to communicate with someone by phone, email, or letter
x: Please contact our customer service department if you have any questions.
如有任何問題，請與我們的客服部門聯絡。
Please update your contact information in the online employee portal.
請在線上員工入口網站更新你的聯絡資訊。
Our sales team stays in close contact with clients throughout the year.
我們的業務團隊全年與客戶保持密切聯繫。
c: (n.) 合約；(v.) 收縮。sign a contract 簽合約。
(n./v.) 對比、對照。in contrast 相比之下。

words.d: to have something inside or to include something as a part
x: The package contains all the parts needed to assemble the bookshelf.
包裹內含組裝書架所需的所有零件。
The report contains important information about next year's marketing budget.
這份報告包含關於明年行銷預算的重要資訊。
Please check that the spreadsheet does not contain any errors.
請檢查這份試算表沒有任何錯誤。
c: (vt.) 包括(部分之一)：The price includes tax.

words.d: a large metal box for transporting goods, or any object used for holding things
x: The shipping containers will arrive at the port on Thursday morning.
貨櫃將於週四上午抵達港口。
Each shipping container holds several thousand boxes of goods.
每個貨櫃可裝載數千箱貨物。
The leftover samples were stored in a large plastic container.
剩餘的樣品被存放在一個大型塑膠容器裡。

words.m: 當代的；現代的；同時代的人
words.d: belonging to the present time or existing now
x: The gallery is hosting an exhibition of contemporary art next month.
美術館下個月將舉辦當代藝術展。
The new lobby features contemporary design and comfortable lounge chairs.
新的大廳採用現代設計和舒適的休閒椅。
The showroom displays contemporary furniture from several European brands.
這間展示間展出來自數個歐洲品牌的現代家具。

words.d: the information or material contained in a document, website, or program
x: The marketing team creates digital content for the company's social media pages.
行銷團隊為公司的社群媒體頁面製作數位內容。
The manager reviewed the content of the report before the meeting.
經理在開會前檢視了報告的內容。
Use the table of contents to find the section on shipping fees.
利用目錄找到關於運費的章節。

words.d: a competition in which people try to win a prize
x: Employees are invited to enter the annual photography contest by Friday.
誠邀員工在週五前報名參加年度攝影比賽。
The bakery held a contest to name its newest dessert.
這家烘焙坊舉辦了一場比賽來為其最新的甜點命名。
The graphic designer won a contest for the best company logo.
這位平面設計師在最佳公司標誌的比賽中獲勝。

words.d: to keep doing something or keep happening without stopping

會議將在中午短暫的午餐休息後繼續進行。
Online orders continue to grow faster than in-store purchases.
線上訂單持續以比實體店購買更快的速度成長。
We will continue the discussion about salaries at next week's meeting.
我們將在下週的會議上繼續討論薪資的問題。

words.d: a legal written agreement between two people or companies
x: Both parties signed the contract after reviewing the payment terms carefully.
雙方在仔細審閱付款條件後簽署了合約。
The supplier agreed to renew the contract for another two years.
供應商同意將合約再續簽兩年。
Please review the contract terms carefully before you sign anything.
在簽署任何文件前，請仔細審閱合約條款。
c: (n.) 協議、同意(可書面或口頭)：reach an agreement 達成協議
(n.) 交易、協議(尤指商業買賣)：close a deal 成交
(v./n.) 聯絡、接觸。contact me 聯絡我。
(n./v.) 對比、對照。in contrast 相比之下。

words.d: a person or company hired to do work, especially building work

承包商承諾在五月底前完成辦公室整修。

公司聘請一位獨立承包商來設計新網站。
The general contractor oversees all the workers on the building site.
總承包商監督工地上所有的工人。

words.d: an obvious difference between two or more things

與去年相比，亞洲市場的銷售額大幅成長。

兩家分店的銷售結果形成鮮明的對比。
By contrast, the online store performed well throughout the quarter.
相較之下，網路商店在整季都表現良好。
c: (n.) 合約；(v.) 收縮。sign a contract 簽合約。
(v./n.) 聯絡、接觸。contact me 聯絡我。

words.d: to give money, ideas, or help in order to achieve something together

每位團隊成員都為新的行銷活動貢獻了寶貴的想法。

可靠的送貨大大促成了這家店的成功。
Local businesses contributed funds to build the new community park.
當地企業捐助資金以興建新的社區公園。

words.d: something you give or do to help make something successful
x: She received an award for her outstanding contribution to the company.
她因對公司的傑出貢獻而獲頒獎項。

公司對災害救助基金做出了慷慨的慈善捐款。
Her research made a significant contribution to the product's design.
她的研究對產品的設計做出了重大的貢獻。

words.d: the power to direct or manage something, or the act of doing so

品管團隊會在每項產品出廠前進行檢驗。

經理引進新措施來控制不斷上升的人力成本。

由於謹慎的規劃，預算現在已牢牢地受到控制。

words.d: the quality of being easy to use or suitable for your needs

請盡早回覆，以便我們確認訂位。

為了方便您，藥局每天營業到午夜。
Please return the signed form at your earliest convenience.
